title: 100m Acceleration & Speed Block 1
summary: High-intensity sprinting development block focusing on explosive starting blocks, mechanics, and transition phase.
riskReason: Potential shin splints or muscle overload if pace is too fast. Avoid sharp accelerations.

warmup.name: Dynamic Joint Activation & Mobility
warmup.notes: Focus on ankle rotations, leg swings, and gentle glute activation before run.

cooldown.name: Gentle Jog recovery & Static stretch
cooldown.notes: Static hamstring stretch, calf stretch, and general cooldown hygiene.

variants.easier: Reduce repetitions by 1-2 blocks or increase rest duration by 30 seconds.
variants.harder: Increase pace by 3-5% or perform 1 extra interval block.

coachingNotes: Maintain tall posture with active glute drive.
Focus on relaxed shoulders and breathing matching target rhythm.
commonMistakes: Starting the main set too quickly in the early repetitions.
Truncating the dynamic warmup exercises.
safetyNotes: Stay fully hydrated.
Cease effort instantly if sudden sharp muscle pulls are experienced.
sourceNote: Athletic Track.Vault production schema validation record.
